items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: They think we’re all supposed to play “Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star” with that Suzuki method.

ctx.x: It’s already a part of her. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

Yeah. And it’s amazing to see at three years old. Man, I had the greatest time. I wish we had — well we’ll talk off the record about my Christmas holidays what I slipped to them. And another thing, since they’re taking lessons — oh well their mother, they work with flash cards. Every morning at 8:30, their mother is teaching them at home. So she makes it fun. Flash cards are those cards, you know what flash cards, but I’m speaking for the people that don’t know, it’s a card with a staff on it and a note, but not…
[scats] My kids did it too. BC: You know the deal.
